title: Guest Services Academy Q&A: Stay-Length Valet Bonus on Guest Folios
content:
Longer reservations receive a stay-length valet bonus per night on the Ashbury Rewards valet savings posted to Guest Folios.

**Rule.** Stay-length valet bonus: a reservation of seven or more nights adds the seven-night valet bonus of $1.00 per night, one of five or six nights adds the five-night valet bonus of $0.50 per night, and a shorter one adds nothing. The bonus is added to the nightly valet saving, and that per-night figure is then taken for each valet line of the stay.

The nights are the reservation's nights on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio — the number of nights between its arrival date and its departure date.

## Questions and answers

**What counts as the length of the stay?** The reservation's nights on the Room Reservations record, not the number of valet lines.

**A reservation of exactly seven nights.** Seven or more: $1.00 per night.

**A reservation of six nights.** Five or six: $0.50 per night.

**A reservation of four nights.** Shorter than five: nothing.

**An eight-night reservation with valet on three nights.** The eight nights decide the bonus, $1.00 per night, taken for each of the three valet lines: $3.00 over the stay.

| Nights on the Room Reservations record | Valet bonus per night |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | $1.00 |
| 5 or 6 | $0.50 |
| 4 or fewer | None |
